items.mainDefect: The `.panel` relies only on `margin-left: auto` to sit on the right, which legacy flexbox implementations (2009 spec and IE10) don't support, so the panel ends up on the left next to the logo.

secondary.defect: The `align-items()` mixin doesn't emit `-moz-box-align`, so old Firefox using `-moz-box` stretches items instead of aligning them.

items.mainDefect: The `align-items()` mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which isn't a real property in any browser, so it's a dead declaration.

secondary.defect: The `align-items()` mixin is missing the `-moz-box-align` counterpart to the `-moz-box` display value that `flexbox()` emits.
